summary: Composits a set of visible sprite objects onto a shared scan-line buffer. Each inner pass zeroes the line buffer (this+0x1A4), checks buffer readiness through this+0x194, then iterates the sprite pointer array at this+0x124, dispatching each visible sprite's draw function from a table and advancing per-element strides. When all lines for a frame are consumed, the frame counters this+0x80/this+0x88 advance; reaching this+0x118 fires a frame-complete callback through this+0x18C and returns 4, otherwise SpriteFrameSelector is invoked and the function returns 3.

Compute frame threshold v13 = this+0x118 minus 1.
Seed v5 (current line) from this+0x19C.
When the current line reaches the limit at this+0x1A0, the frame scan is finished.
Advance frame counters: increment this+0x88 and this+0x80.
When this+0x80 reaches this+0x118 the animation frame limit is hit.
Invoke the frame-complete callback at (this+0x18C)+12 and return 4.
Return 4 to signal frame sequence completion.
Otherwise call SpriteFrameSelector and return 3 to advance to the next sprite frame.

Poll buffer readiness via the callback at (this+0x194)+4; a false return breaks the pass loop.
Sprite compositing loop runs only when the sprite count this+0x120 is greater than 0.
Iterate the sprite descriptor pointer array at this+0x124 (a1+73) for this+0x120 entries.
A sprite is processed when the visibility byte at its +0x30 is nonzero; hidden sprites only advance the accumulator by the +0x3C stride.
Select the sprite's draw function pointer from the table at this+0x198 indexed by the sprite type field at +0x4.
Choose the sprite source offset +0x44 on high lines or +0x34 otherwise, and compute the row base as v26 times the +0x40 multiplier.
Inner loop over sprite +0x38 elements, clipped by the this+0x80/v13 frame guard and the +0x48 scan threshold.
Dispatch the sprite draw callback per element, advancing the output cursor by the sprite +0x24 stride each call.
Write back this+0x19C = last line and this+0x198 = final scan position, then return 0.
ABI: __cdecl(_DWORD* a1, int a2); a2 is a per-sprite base-offset array indexed by the sprite ordinal.
